name: Sichuan Biokin Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Biokin Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of biomedicine in the fields of antibody drug conjugate, guidance navigation and control, and antibody radionuclide conjugate in China and internationally. It offers anesthesia, parenteral nutrition, anti-infectives, pediatrics, and traditional Chinese medicines. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Chengdu, China.
